en: Hold it! I'm so thirsty I can hardly think. Nobody gets through until I've had a drink.
Hold it! I'm so thirsty... Oh! Is that tea? May I?
Ah, wonderful! I'll share it with the other guards. You're free to go through!
Hi, how's it going? Saffron City's closed for now, I'm afraid.
Hi, how's it going? Thanks for the tea, by the way!
